```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
source(file.path("R", "common.R"))
library(knitr)
TEX <- "results_gm12878_parameters.tex"
# check a quoted value given to `digits` decimals: ok if it is the computed value rounded (half up
# or half down, so 93.45 may be quoted as 93.4 or 93.5)
chk <- function(label, value, quoted, digits = 1) {
  check_text(label, round(value, digits + 2), quoted, tol = 0.5 * 10^-digits + 1e-6)
  invisible(value)
}
```

This notebook supports the Results section "Parameter choices on real assemblies"
([`../manuscript/sections/results_gm12878_parameters.tex`](../manuscript/sections/results_gm12878_parameters.tex),
`sec:parameters`) and Fig. 7 (`fig:parameters`, caption in
[`figures_main.tex`](../manuscript/sections/figures_main.tex)). It draws Fig. 7
(`figures/fig7_parameters.{pdf,png}`) and computes the numbers the section quotes.
Provenance: `r evidence("E13")` (start-parameter grid), `r evidence("E04")` (minimum length),
`r evidence("E20")` and `r evidence("E22")` (q-value test, development runs), `r evidence("E06")`
(homology series; release rerun with PyTD a5b24c3) and `r evidence("E25")` (release runs).

**Which runs.** The release runs (E25: PyTD 3a793ff; q-value test at q 0.05, 50-codon minimum,
start refinement alpha 0.4, Kozak 17 per bit) are used where an equivalent exists or could be
derived:

- Fig. 7b (post-hoc minimum length) and the minimum-length paragraph: release ab initio predictions,
  re-evaluated with `--min-aa` (`pipeline/derive/08_minaa_sweep_final_v7.sh`).
- Fig. 7b markers: the three q settings of the release (`--precise`, default, `--sensitive`). These
  replace the earlier markers (pre-defined LongOrfs minimum runs from development code), as the
  caption's `\todo` asks.
- The q-value paragraph: release protein matches and a release version of the dropped-ORF support
  table (`pipeline/derive/08_rule_support_v7.py`).
- The homology series (Fig. 7c, d) and the transposable-element paragraph: release rerun with PyTD
  a5b24c3 (homology-assisted start refinement on; `pipeline/derive/08_homology_series_v7h.sh`, E06
  "Release rerun"). The development series (48c870c) is tabulated for comparison.

No release equivalent exists for:

- the start-parameter grid (Fig. 7a; development code 48c870c, E13). Fig. 7a adds the release
  default as one extra point per assembly;
- the comparison of pre-defined LongOrfs minima (`-m 100`, `-m 50` without a test; E04).

These use the data of the earlier figure.

```{r data}
ASM <- c("lraa", "stringtie", "trinity")
SHORT <- c(lraa = "LRAA", stringtie = "StringTie", trinity = "Trinity")
asm_factor <- function(x) factor(x, levels = ASM, labels = ASM_LABEL[ASM])

# key/value eval summaries (eval_genome_cds.py)
kv <- function(...) {
  x <- readr::read_tsv(data_path(...), col_names = c("key", "value"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                       col_types = "cc")
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$value)); names(v) <- x$key; v
}
rel_eval <- function(asm, setting = "default") {
  suf <- if (setting == "default") "" else paste0("_", setting)
  kv("benchmark", "final_v7", sprintf("eval.%s_final_v7_abinitio%s.summary.tsv", asm, suf))
}
```

## Start refinement {#start-refinement}

Source: `data/start_param_sensitivity/gm12878.tsv` (E13; development code 48c870c, identical to the
earlier `final_abinitio` runs at alpha 0.4, w 25 per nat). The grid weight is per nat; 25 per nat
is 17.3 per bit, and the shipped 17 per bit differs by rounding only (E13 addendum). The grid was run
on LRAA and StringTie only. Rows: no refinement (`norefine`), the default (`a0.4_w25`), the default
without the Kozak term (`a0.4_w0`) and alpha 1.0 (`a1.0_w25`).

```{r start}
g <- function(a, cfg, col) grid[[col]][grid$assembly == a & grid$config == cfg]
start_tab <- grid %>% filter(config %in% c("norefine", "a0.4_w0", "a0.4_w25", "a1.0_w25")) %>%
  transmute(assembly, config, `MANE exact given assembled` = MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
            `complete, GENCODE exact` = pred_complete_gencode_exact,
            `complete, compatible not exact` = pred_complete_compatible_not_exact,
            `5'-partial` = distinct_predicted_5prime_partial,
            `exact-start share` = pred_complete_start_precision)
kable(start_tab)
```

- Exact recovery of fully assembled MANE CDSs, no refinement to default: StringTie
  `r pct(g("stringtie","norefine","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))` to
  `r pct(g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`, LRAA
  `r pct(g("lraa","norefine","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))` to
  `r pct(g("lraa","a0.4_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`.
- Exact complete calls: `r num(g("stringtie","norefine","pred_complete_gencode_exact"))` to
  `r num(g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_gencode_exact"))` and
  `r num(g("lraa","norefine","pred_complete_gencode_exact"))` to
  `r num(g("lraa","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_gencode_exact"))`. 5'-partial calls:
  `r num(g("stringtie","norefine","distinct_predicted_5prime_partial"))` to
  `r num(g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","distinct_predicted_5prime_partial"))` and
  `r num(g("lraa","norefine","distinct_predicted_5prime_partial"))` to
  `r num(g("lraa","a0.4_w25","distinct_predicted_5prime_partial"))`.
- Exact-start share of GENCODE-compatible complete calls:
  `r pct(g("stringtie","norefine","pred_complete_start_precision"))` to
  `r pct(g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_start_precision"))` and
  `r pct(g("lraa","norefine","pred_complete_start_precision"))` to
  `r pct(g("lraa","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_start_precision"))`.
- Wrong-start complete calls (compatible, not exact):
  `r num(g("stringtie","norefine","pred_complete_compatible_not_exact"))` to
  `r num(g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_compatible_not_exact"))` and
  `r num(g("lraa","norefine","pred_complete_compatible_not_exact"))` to
  `r num(g("lraa","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_compatible_not_exact"))`.
- Kozak term (w 25 vs 0 at alpha 0.4): `r f1(100 * (g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled") - g("stringtie","a0.4_w0","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled")))`
  and `r f1(100 * (g("lraa","a0.4_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled") - g("lraa","a0.4_w0","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled")))`
  points of MANE exact recovery; `r f1(100 * (g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_start_precision") - g("stringtie","a0.4_w0","pred_complete_start_precision")))`
  and `r f1(100 * (g("lraa","a0.4_w25","pred_complete_start_precision") - g("lraa","a0.4_w0","pred_complete_start_precision")))`
  points of exact-start share.
- alpha 0.4 to 1.0: MANE exact given assembled StringTie
  `r pct(g("stringtie","a0.4_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))` to
  `r pct(g("stringtie","a1.0_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`, LRAA
  `r pct(g("lraa","a0.4_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))` to
  `r pct(g("lraa","a1.0_w25","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`; wrong-start complete calls
  `r num(g("stringtie","a1.0_w25","pred_complete_compatible_not_exact"))` and
  `r num(g("lraa","a1.0_w25","pred_complete_compatible_not_exact"))`; exact-start share
  `r pct(g("stringtie","a1.0_w25","pred_complete_start_precision"))` and
  `r pct(g("lraa","a1.0_w25","pred_complete_start_precision"))`.

**Release runs** (E25; q-value test, w 17 per bit). The exact-start share is computed in the same
way from the release `pred_status` tables (`08_start_share.tsv`; the earlier `final_abinitio` rows
reproduce the grid's default cell exactly):

```{r start_release}
rel_start <- start_share %>% filter(run == "final_v7_abinitio") %>%
  mutate(mane = sapply(assembly, function(a) rel_eval(a)[["MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"]]))
stopifnot(with(start_share %>% filter(run == "final_abinitio", assembly != "trinity"),
               all(abs(share - c(g("lraa", "a0.4_w25", "pred_complete_start_precision"),
                                 g("stringtie", "a0.4_w25", "pred_complete_start_precision"))) < 1e-4)))
kable(start_share %>% mutate(share = round(share, 4)))
```

Release default: MANE exact given assembled LRAA `r pct(rel_start$mane[1])`, StringTie
`r pct(rel_start$mane[2])`, Trinity `r pct(rel_start$mane[3])`; exact-start share
`r pct(rel_start$share[1])`, `r pct(rel_start$share[2])`, `r pct(rel_start$share[3])`.
The q-value test removes some complete calls, which raises the share slightly and lowers MANE exact
recovery (E25). The text's start-refinement numbers are from the grid and stay valid as a
description of the refinement step; the default point in Fig. 7a differs from the release by the
ORF acceptance rule.

`r evidence("E13")`, `r evidence("E09")`, `r evidence("E25")`

## Minimum length and the q-value cutoff {#minimum-length-and-the-q-value-cutoff}

### A 50-codon minimum without a test (development runs) {#minimum-without-test}

Runs with a pre-defined LongOrfs minimum and no short-ORF test exist only from development code
(E04: `m50`, and `kozak_add` = `-m 100`; `data/gm12878/eval_summaries/`). There is no release
equivalent.

```{r m50}
dev_sum <- function(a, cfg) kv("gm12878", "eval_summaries", sprintf("%s_%s.summary.tsv", a, cfg))
m50_tab <- expand_grid(assembly = c("lraa", "stringtie"),
                       config = c("kozak_add", "m50", "m50_sc200")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(run = c(kozak_add = "-m 100", m50 = "-m 50, no test",
                 m50_sc200 = "-m 50 + fixed short-ORF test")[config],
         distinct_cds = dev_sum(assembly, config)[["distinct_predicted_cds"]],
         MANE_exact_given_assembled = dev_sum(assembly, config)[["MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"]],
         no_GENCODE_overlap = dev_sum(assembly, config)[["pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"]]) %>%
  ungroup()
kable(m50_tab)
nov <- function(a, cfg) m50_tab$no_GENCODE_overlap[m50_tab$assembly == a & m50_tab$config == cfg]
```

No GENCODE CDS overlap, `-m 100` to `-m 50` without a test: LRAA `r pct(nov("lraa","kozak_add"))`
to `r pct(nov("lraa","m50"))`, StringTie `r pct(nov("stringtie","kozak_add"))` to
`r pct(nov("stringtie","m50"))`. For comparison, the release default gives
`r pct(rel_eval("lraa")[["pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"]])` (LRAA),
`r pct(rel_eval("stringtie")[["pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"]])` (StringTie) and
`r pct(rel_eval("trinity")[["pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"]])` (Trinity) (E25).

`r evidence("E04")`, `r evidence("E25")`

```{r chk_m50, include = FALSE}
chk("L31 LRAA no-overlap, -m 100 (%)", 100 * nov("lraa", "kozak_add"), 3.6)
chk("L31 LRAA no-overlap, -m 50 no test (%)", 100 * nov("lraa", "m50"), 10.7)
chk("L32 StringTie no-overlap, -m 100 (%)", 100 * nov("stringtie", "kozak_add"), 11.8)
chk("L32 StringTie no-overlap, -m 50 no test (%)", 100 * nov("stringtie", "m50"), 34.7)
```

### Matching and non-matching proteins by q setting {#q-settings}

Predicted proteins identical to, or sharing an exact 30-residue window with, a GENCODE v50 protein
are "matching"; the rest are "non-matching" (`score_protein_matches.py`). Release runs:
`data/benchmark/final_v7/gm12878_v7_protein_matches.tsv` (E25). The development runs quoted in the
current text (E22) and the fixed short-ORF test (`cliff_c200`) are in
`data/benchmark/qmodes/gm12878_qmodes_protein_matches.tsv`.

```{r qset}
SETTING <- c(precise = "q 0.01 (--precise)", default = "q 0.05 (default)",
             sensitive = "q 0.2 (--sensitive)")
dev_map <- c(precise = "decoy_q0.01_longgc", default = "decoy_q0.05_longgc",
             sensitive = "decoy_q0.2_longgc")
q_tab <- pm_v7 %>% select(assembly, setting, matching = true_positives, nonmatching) %>%
  left_join(pm_dev %>% filter(setting %in% dev_map) %>%
              mutate(setting = names(dev_map)[match(setting, dev_map)]) %>%
              select(assembly, setting, dev_matching = true_positives, dev_nonmatching = nonmatching),
            by = c("assembly", "setting")) %>%
  mutate(no_GENCODE_overlap = mapply(function(a, s) rel_eval(a, s)[["pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"]],
                                     assembly, setting),
         MANE_exact_given_assembled = mapply(function(a, s) rel_eval(a, s)[["MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"]],
                                             assembly, setting),
         catalog_riboseq_orfs = cat_v7$stop_match[match(
           paste0(assembly, "_final_v7_abinitio", ifelse(setting == "default", "", paste0("_", setting))),
           cat_v7$run)])
cliff <- pm_dev %>% filter(setting == "cliff_c200") %>% select(assembly, matching = true_positives, nonmatching)
kable(q_tab %>% mutate(setting = SETTING[setting]))
kable(cliff, caption = "Fixed short-ORF test (development run cliff_c200)")
q <- function(a, s, col) q_tab[[col]][q_tab$assembly == a & q_tab$setting == s]
cl <- function(a, col) cliff[[col]][cliff$assembly == a]
fold <- sapply(c("lraa", "stringtie"), function(a) cl(a, "nonmatching") / q(a, "default", "nonmatching"))
loss <- sapply(c("lraa", "stringtie"), function(a) 1 - q(a, "default", "matching") / cl(a, "matching"))
fold_dev <- sapply(c("lraa", "stringtie"), function(a) cl(a, "nonmatching") / q(a, "default", "dev_nonmatching"))
loss_dev <- sapply(c("lraa", "stringtie"), function(a) 1 - q(a, "default", "dev_matching") / cl(a, "matching"))
```

Release runs, matching / non-matching (LRAA; StringTie):

- default q 0.05: `r num(q("lraa","default","matching"))` / `r num(q("lraa","default","nonmatching"))`;
  `r num(q("stringtie","default","matching"))` / `r num(q("stringtie","default","nonmatching"))`.
  Trinity: `r num(q("trinity","default","matching"))` / `r num(q("trinity","default","nonmatching"))`.
- fixed short-ORF test (development): `r num(cl("lraa","matching"))` / `r num(cl("lraa","nonmatching"))`;
  `r num(cl("stringtie","matching"))` / `r num(cl("stringtie","nonmatching"))`.
- q 0.01: `r num(q("lraa","precise","matching"))` / `r num(q("lraa","precise","nonmatching"))`;
  `r num(q("stringtie","precise","matching"))` / `r num(q("stringtie","precise","nonmatching"))`.
- q 0.2: `r num(q("lraa","sensitive","matching"))` / `r num(q("lraa","sensitive","nonmatching"))`;
  `r num(q("stringtie","sensitive","matching"))` / `r num(q("stringtie","sensitive","nonmatching"))`.

At the default, non-matching proteins fell `r sprintf("%.1f", fold[1])`-fold (LRAA) and
`r sprintf("%.1f", fold[2])`-fold (StringTie), for a loss of `r pct(loss[1])` and `r pct(loss[2])` of
matching ones (development runs: `r sprintf("%.1f", fold_dev[1])` and `r sprintf("%.1f", fold_dev[2])`-fold,
`r pct(loss_dev[1])` and `r pct(loss_dev[2])`). The no-GENCODE-overlap share of release predictions is
`r pct(q("lraa","precise","no_GENCODE_overlap"))` / `r pct(q("lraa","default","no_GENCODE_overlap"))` /
`r pct(q("lraa","sensitive","no_GENCODE_overlap"))` (LRAA; q 0.01 / 0.05 / 0.2) and
`r pct(q("stringtie","precise","no_GENCODE_overlap"))` / `r pct(q("stringtie","default","no_GENCODE_overlap"))` /
`r pct(q("stringtie","sensitive","no_GENCODE_overlap"))` (StringTie). Catalogued Ribo-seq ORFs matched
by stop codon fall from 178 / 217 / 455 with the fixed short-ORF test (E04, E25) to
`r q("lraa","default","catalog_riboseq_orfs")` / `r q("stringtie","default","catalog_riboseq_orfs")` /
`r q("trinity","default","catalog_riboseq_orfs")` at the default.

`r evidence("E22")`, `r evidence("E20")`, `r evidence("E25")`


### Support of the ORFs that the q-value test removed {#removed-orf-support}

The text quotes the release version. An earlier draft quoted `gm12878_rule_support.tsv` (E20/E22;
development run `decoy_q0.05`, without long-ORF retention, against the development fixed short-ORF
run `cliff_c200`), shown below for comparison. The release version,
`data/gm12878/final_v7/08_rule_support_v7.tsv` (`pipeline/derive/08_rule_support_v7.py`), compares
the release runs with the earlier `final_abinitio` runs (fixed short-ORF test; their Ribo-seq and MS
tables from E01/E02). An ORF is identified by transcript, strand and stop codon. "dropped" are
`final_abinitio` ORFs with no release prediction with that stop; "all" are the release predictions,
scored with the release Ribo-seq and MS tables (E25). Ribo-seq rates are over ORFs with at least ten
P-sites; MS rates are over all ORFs (gene models).

```{r support}
kable(sup_v7, caption = "Release (08_rule_support_v7.tsv)")
s7 <- function(a, st, set, col) sup_v7[[col]][sup_v7$asm == a & sup_v7$setting == st & sup_v7$set == set]
sd <- function(a, set, col) sup_dev[[col]][sup_dev$asm == a & sup_dev$label == "decoy_q0.05" & sup_dev$set == set]
kable(sup_dev %>% filter(label %in% c("cliff_c200", "decoy_q0.05")),
      caption = "Development (gm12878_rule_support.tsv), as quoted in an earlier draft")
```

Release default, ORFs removed vs all predictions (LRAA; StringTie; Trinity):

- Ribo-seq frame test passed: `r pct(s7("lraa","default","dropped","ribo_rate"), 0)`,
  `r pct(s7("stringtie","default","dropped","ribo_rate"), 0)`, `r pct(s7("trinity","default","dropped","ribo_rate"), 0)`
  of removed ORFs with enough footprints (n = `r s7("lraa","default","dropped","ribo_n")`,
  `r s7("stringtie","default","dropped","ribo_n")`, `r num(s7("trinity","default","dropped","ribo_n"))`), against
  `r pct(s7("lraa","default","all","ribo_rate"), 0)`, `r pct(s7("stringtie","default","all","ribo_rate"), 0)`,
  `r pct(s7("trinity","default","all","ribo_rate"), 0)` of all predictions.
- MS peptide: `r pct(s7("lraa","default","dropped","ms_rate"), 0)`, `r pct(s7("stringtie","default","dropped","ms_rate"), 0)`,
  `r pct(s7("trinity","default","dropped","ms_rate"), 0)` against `r pct(s7("lraa","default","all","ms_rate"), 0)`,
  `r pct(s7("stringtie","default","all","ms_rate"), 0)`, `r pct(s7("trinity","default","all","ms_rate"), 0)`.

The development values quoted in an earlier draft (40% and 35% vs 66% and 62%; MS 35% and 20% vs 65%
and 70%) are
`r pct(sd("lraa","dropped","ribo_rate"),0)` / `r pct(sd("stringtie","dropped","ribo_rate"),0)` vs
`r pct(sd("lraa","all","ribo_rate"),0)` / `r pct(sd("stringtie","all","ribo_rate"),0)`, and
`r pct(sd("lraa","dropped","ms_rate"),0)` / `r pct(sd("stringtie","dropped","ms_rate"),0)` vs
`r pct(sd("lraa","all","ms_rate"),0)` / `r pct(sd("stringtie","all","ms_rate"),0)`.

### Post-hoc minimum length {#post-hoc-minimum-length}

`eval_genome_cds.py --min-aa L` on the release default predictions
(`data/gm12878/final_v7/08_minaa_sweep_v7.tsv`; same procedure as E04, which used the earlier
`final_abinitio` predictions, `data/gm12878/gm12878_minaa_sweep.tsv`). The filter keeps predictions
encoding at least L aa (stop excluded); it is applied after prediction, so training and
per-transcript selection still see all candidates.

```{r minaa}
mt <- sweep_v7 %>% select(assembly, min_aa, distinct_predicted_cds, MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
                          pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac) %>%
  left_join(sweep_dev %>% select(assembly, min_aa, dev_MANE = MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
                                 dev_no_overlap = pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac),
            by = c("assembly", "min_aa"))
kable(mt, digits = 4)
mv <- function(a, L, col) sweep_v7[[col]][sweep_v7$assembly == a & sweep_v7$min_aa == L]
full_mane <- sapply(ASM, function(a) rel_eval(a)[["MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"]])
```

Removing release predictions below 150 aa cuts the no-overlap share to
`r pct(mv("lraa",150,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"))` (LRAA),

assembled falls from `r sprintf("%.2f", full_mane[1])`, `r sprintf("%.2f", full_mane[2])` and
`r sprintf("%.2f", full_mane[3])` (unfiltered) to `r sprintf("%.2f", mv("lraa",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`,
`r sprintf("%.2f", mv("stringtie",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))` and
`r sprintf("%.2f", mv("trinity",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`. Between 50 and 100 aa, MANE
exact given assembled changes by
`r paste(sprintf("%.3f", sapply(ASM, function(a) mv(a,100,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled") - mv(a,50,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))), collapse = ", ")`
and the no-overlap share by
`r paste(sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sapply(ASM, function(a) mv(a,100,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac") - mv(a,50,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"))), collapse = ", ")`

## Homology evidence and evolutionary distance {#homology-evidence-and-evolutionary-distance}

Source: `data/gm12878/gm12878_homology_series_v7h.tsv` (E06 release rerun; PyTD a5b24c3 with the
homology-assisted start refinement, release defaults; one fresh LongOrfs per assembly, identical to
the release ab initio run's; ab initio row = a fresh a5b24c3 run, byte-identical to the E25 release
run). Change = configuration minus ab initio. The development series (`gm12878_homology_series.tsv`,
48c870c, fixed short-ORF test) is compared below.

```{r homology}
CLADES <- c("9606" = "human", "9443" = "primates", "40674" = "mammals", "7742" = "vertebrates",
            "33208" = "animals")
h <- function(a, cfg, col) hom[[col]][hom$assembly == a & hom$config == cfg]
hom_d <- hom %>% group_by(assembly) %>%
  mutate(d_mane_exact_pts = 100 * (MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled - MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled[config == "abinitio"]),
         d_mane_compat_pts = 100 * (MANE_sens_compatible - MANE_sens_compatible[config == "abinitio"]),
         d_distinct_cds = distinct_predicted_cds - distinct_predicted_cds[config == "abinitio"]) %>%
  ungroup()
kable(hom_d %>% select(assembly, config, distinct_predicted_cds, MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
                       d_mane_exact_pts, d_mane_compat_pts, d_distinct_cds), digits = 3)
dh <- function(a, cfg, col) hom_d[[col]][hom_d$assembly == a & hom_d$config == cfg]
```

- Swiss-Prot minus human, MANE exact given assembled: +`r f1(dh("lraa","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`
  (LRAA), +`r f1(dh("stringtie","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))` (StringTie),
  +`r f1(dh("trinity","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))` (Trinity) points; MANE compatible
  +`r f1(dh("lraa","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_compat_pts"))`, +`r f1(dh("stringtie","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_compat_pts"))`,
  +`r f1(dh("trinity","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_compat_pts"))`.
- Minus all animals: +`r f1(dh("lraa","blast_33208_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`,
  +`r f1(dh("stringtie","blast_33208_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`, +`r f1(dh("trinity","blast_33208_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`.
- Pfam alone: `r pct(h("lraa","pfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`, `r pct(h("stringtie","pfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`,
  `r pct(h("trinity","pfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`; Swiss-Prot minus human:
  `r pct(h("lraa","blast_9606_nopfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`, `r pct(h("stringtie","blast_9606_nopfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`,
  `r pct(h("trinity","blast_9606_nopfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`.

## Homology to transposable elements retains short unannotated ORFs {#homology-to-transposable-elements}

Source: `data/gm12878/gm12878_homology_primate_retention_v7h.txt` (E06 release rerun;
`homology_series_retention.py`, Swiss-Prot minus human vs minus primates, BLAST only). Parsed below;
the development values (`gm12878_homology_primate_retention.txt`) follow.

```{r retention}
prot_n <- function(line, prot) {
  m <- regmatches(line, regexec(sprintf("\\('%s', (\\d+)\\)", prot), line))[[1]]
  if (length(m) == 2) as.integer(m[2]) else 0L
}
parse_ret <- function(asm, txt = ret_txt) {
  i <- which(txt == paste("==", asm))
  blk <- txt[(i + 1):(i + 4)]
  n_only <- as.integer(sub("in A only: (\\d+) .*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  novel <- as.integer(sub(".*'novel': (\\d+).*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  short <- as.integer(sub(".*short\\(<100aa\\): (\\d+).*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  tibble(assembly = asm, only_minus_human = n_only, unannotated = novel, short_lt100 = short,
         best_hit_UTY_PANTR = prot_n(blk[3], "UTY_PANTR"), best_hit_LIN1_NYCCO = prot_n(blk[3], "LIN1_NYCCO"),
         best_hit_LORF2_MOUSE = prot_n(blk[3], "LORF2_MOUSE"))
}
ret <- bind_rows(parse_ret("trinity"), parse_ret("stringtie"), parse_ret("lraa"))
ret_dev <- bind_rows(parse_ret("trinity", ret_txt_dev), parse_ret("stringtie", ret_txt_dev))
kable(ret, caption = "Release (a5b24c3)")
kable(ret_dev, caption = "Development (48c870c)")
r <- function(a, col) ret[[col]][ret$assembly == a]
```

Trinity: `r num(r("trinity","only_minus_human"))` distinct CDSs with Swiss-Prot minus human but not
minus primates; `r num(r("trinity","unannotated"))` with no annotated CDS overlap;
`r pct(r("trinity","short_lt100") / r("trinity","only_minus_human"), 0)` encode fewer than 100 aa
(`r num(r("trinity","short_lt100"))`, counted over all `r num(r("trinity","only_minus_human"))`);
`r num(r("trinity","best_hit_UTY_PANTR"))` have chimpanzee UTY as best hit and
`r r("trinity","best_hit_LIN1_NYCCO")` a primate LINE-1 protein (LIN1_NYCCO). MANE exact (all MANE):
`r sprintf("%.4f", h("trinity","blast_9606_nopfam","MANE_sens_exact"))` (minus human) and
`r sprintf("%.4f", h("trinity","blast_9443_nopfam","MANE_sens_exact"))` (minus primates). StringTie:
`r num(r("stringtie","best_hit_UTY_PANTR"))` of `r num(r("stringtie","unannotated"))`.
These numbers also appear in the Fig. 7d annotation.

`r evidence("E06")`

Transposable-element screen (`pipeline/derive/08_te_screen_check_v7h.sh`, the recipe of PyTD
`docs/homology_te_screen.md`, d3892b5): ORFs predicted with Swiss-Prot minus human (BLAST only) but not
ab initio, flagged by best-hit name, by at least half of the CDS in RepeatMasker TEs, or either.

## Figure 7 {#figure-7}

Port of `figures/fig7_parameters/make_fig7.py`, with two changes, both to use the release runs:

- (a) The release default (q-value test, w 17 per bit) is added as a cross per assembly; the grid is unchanged.
- (b) Lines are the post-hoc filter on the release predictions. Markers are the release q settings
  at the 50-codon minimum: q 0.01, q 0.05 (default) and q 0.2 (drawn at 45, 50 and 55 aa so they do
  not overlap). They replace the earlier
  pre-defined-minimum runs from development code. Trinity was run at the default only.

Panels c and d use the release homology series (PyTD a5b24c3; E06 release rerun); they replace the
development series (48c870c).

```{r fig7_panels}
# (a) start refinement
pa_dat <- grid %>% filter(assembly %in% c("lraa", "stringtie"), config != "norefine", weight %in% c(0, 25)) %>%
  mutate(w = ifelse(weight == 25, "w = 17/bit", "w = 0"))
pa_lab <- pa_dat %>% filter(weight == 25, alpha %in% c(0.2, 1.0)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("α = ", alpha))
pa_def <- pa_dat %>% filter(weight == 25, alpha == 0.4)
pa_rel <- rel_start %>% filter(assembly != "trinity")
pa <- ggplot(pa_dat, aes(MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled, pred_complete_start_precision,
                         colour = assembly, group = interaction(assembly, w))) +
  geom_path(aes(linetype = w), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = w), size = 1.1, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = pa_def, aes(group = NULL), shape = 21, size = 3, colour = "black", stroke = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = pa_rel, aes(mane, share, group = NULL), shape = 4, size = 1.8, stroke = 0.6,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = pa_lab, aes(label = label, group = NULL, hjust = ifelse(alpha < 0.5, 1.15, -0.1),
                               vjust = ifelse(alpha < 0.5, 0.5, 1.3)),
            size = 1.95, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, labels = ASM_LABEL, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("w = 17/bit" = "solid", "w = 0" = "22"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("w = 17/bit" = 16, "w = 0" = 21), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.83, 0.975)) +
  labs(x = "MANE exact given assembled", y = "exact-start share of\ncompatible complete calls",
       title = "Start refinement (α)", caption = "large circle: default (grid);  ×: release, q 0.05") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 5.5, hjust = 0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.5), legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
        legend.key.width = unit(5, "mm"))

# (b) minimum length
QSET <- c(precise = "q 0.01", default = "q 0.05 (default)", sensitive = "q 0.2")
QSHAPE <- c("q 0.01" = 25, "q 0.05 (default)" = 23, "q 0.2" = 24)
pb_lines <- sweep_v7 %>% mutate(assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
# markers drawn at 45 / 50 / 55 aa so they do not overlap; all three runs use the 50-codon minimum
pb_pts <- q_tab %>% mutate(qs = factor(QSET[setting], levels = QSET),
                           min_aa = c(precise = 45, default = 50, sensitive = 55)[setting],
                           assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
panel_b <- function(col_line, col_pt, ylab, title, legend = FALSE) {
  ggplot(pb_lines, aes(min_aa, .data[[col_line]], colour = assembly)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 50, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = pb_pts, aes(y = .data[[col_pt]], shape = qs), fill = "white", size = 1.6,
               stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = QSHAPE, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 100, 150, 200, 300)) +
    labs(x = "minimum protein length (aa)", y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme(legend.position = if (legend) "inside" else "none", legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98), legend.justification = c(1, 1))
}
pb1 <- panel_b("MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled", "MANE_exact_given_assembled",
               "MANE exact given\nassembled", "Minimum length: accuracy")
pb2 <- panel_b("pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac", "no_GENCODE_overlap",
               "no GENCODE CDS\noverlap (fraction)", "Minimum length: unannotated", legend = TRUE)

# (c, d) homology
XLEV <- c(paste0("−", CLADES), "Pfam\nonly")
PFAM_X <- 5.6
hom_pl <- hom_d %>% filter(config != "abinitio") %>%
  mutate(taxid = sub("blast_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", config),
         db = case_when(config == "pfam" ~ "Pfam only",
                        grepl("_nopfam$", config) ~ "Swiss-Prot",
                        TRUE ~ "Swiss-Prot + Pfam"),
         x = ifelse(config == "pfam", "Pfam\nonly", paste0("−", CLADES[taxid])),
         xn = ifelse(config == "pfam", PFAM_X, match(x, XLEV)),
         assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
panel_cd <- function(col, scale, ylab, title) {
  d <- hom_pl %>% mutate(y = .data[[col]] * scale)
  ggplot(d %>% filter(db != "Pfam only"), aes(xn, y, colour = assembly,
                                               group = interaction(assembly, db))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = db), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = db), size = 1.1, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(db == "Pfam only"), aes(shape = db, linetype = db), size = 1.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Swiss-Prot" = "solid", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam" = "22", "Pfam only" = "blank"),
                          breaks = c("Swiss-Prot", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam", "Pfam only"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Swiss-Prot" = 16, "Swiss-Prot + Pfam" = 21, "Pfam only" = 18),
                       breaks = c("Swiss-Prot", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam", "Pfam only"), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1:5, PFAM_X), labels = XLEV, limits = c(0.6, 5.9)) +
    labs(x = "Swiss-Prot with clade removed", y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
pc <- panel_cd("d_mane_exact_pts", 1, "Δ MANE exact given assembled\n(percentage points)",
               "Homology evidence: accuracy") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.02), legend.justification = c(0, 0), legend.key.width = unit(5, "mm"))
uty_y <- dh("trinity", "blast_9606_nopfam", "d_distinct_cds") / 1000
pd <- panel_cd("d_distinct_cds", 1e-3, "Δ distinct predicted CDSs\n(thousands)",
               "Homology evidence: predictions") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  annotate("segment", x = 1.08, xend = 1.9, y = uty_y, yend = uty_y * 0.98, linewidth = 0.25,
           colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.95, y = uty_y * 0.98, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.8, size = 1.95,
           label = paste0(num(r("trinity", "best_hit_UTY_PANTR")),
                          " short unannotated ORFs kept only\nby homology to the Alu-encoded\n",
                          "C-terminus of chimpanzee UTY"))

# shared assembly legend
leg <- ggplot(tibble(assembly = factor(ASM, levels = ASM), x = 1, y = 1), aes(x, y, fill = assembly)) +
  geom_tile(alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, labels = ASM_LABEL, name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), nrow = 1)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.key.spacing.x = unit(3, "mm"))
get_legend <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  i <- which(grepl("guide-box", sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name)) &
             !sapply(g$grobs, inherits, "zeroGrob"))
  g$grobs[[i[1]]]
}
leg <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = get_legend(leg))

fig7 <- leg / ((pa | pb1 | pb2) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1))) / ((pc | pd)) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.06, 1, 1.05)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("", "a", "b", "", "c", "d")))
png_f <- save_fig(fig7, "fig7_parameters", FULL_W, 5.0)
```

```{r fig7_show, fig.width = 6.69, fig.height = 5.0, out.width = "100%"}
fig7
```
